settings.heading: Flooring
settings.lead: Durable, beautiful floors installed level and seamless — for one room, a whole house or a commercial space. We prep the subfloor right so your new floor looks great for years.

settings.heading: The right floor, installed the right way
settings.text: A great floor starts underneath. We remove the old flooring, repair and level the subfloor, then install your new floor with tight seams, clean transitions and fresh baseboards. Not sure which material fits your space? We'll help you choose.
settings.items:
Old flooring removal
Subfloor leveling & repair
Underlayment & moisture barrier
Precise cuts & transitions
Baseboards & quarter round
Stairs matched to your floor

settings.heading: Flooring We Install
settings.subheading: Not sure which one fits your space? We'll walk you through the pros and cons at your free estimate.

settings.title: Vinyl Plank (LVP)
settings.text: Waterproof, scratch-resistant and great for kitchens, basements, bathrooms and rentals.

settings.title: Laminate
settings.text: Realistic wood looks at a great price, ideal for bedrooms and living areas.

settings.title: Hardwood
settings.text: Timeless, natural wood that adds warmth and value to any home.

settings.title: Tile
settings.text: Porcelain and ceramic for bathrooms, entries, kitchens and laundry rooms.
